description: This file contains shell script code for testing diff algorithms on C source code files, including functions that generate diff outputs and tests that compare expected diff results. It is primarily used for testing and utility purposes related to diff algorithms, not a source code defining application logic.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Sets up and runs tests comparing diff outputs between generated C source files with modifications, using different diff algorithms specified by input parameter.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Tests diff output for two completely different simple text files, verifying diff algorithm behavior.
